caseName: Southern Railway Co. v. Seaboard Allied Milling Corp.
caseNameFull: Southern Railway Co. v. Seaboard Allied Milling Corp. Interstate Commerce Commission v. Seaboard Allied Milling Corp. and Seaboard Coast Line Railroad Co. v. Seaboard Allied Milling Corp.

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. [Cer-tiorari granted, 439 U. S. 1066.] Motion of the Solicitor General for additional time for oral argument granted, and 15 minutes allotted for that purpose.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
